implementedCorrection.summary: Added an explicit RESEARCH_TASK routing branch to the workflow's enforcement-resolution step. A canonical research/** head on base main now prints 'ENFORCEMENT: RESEARCH_TASK (protected base policy)', executes the validator from a detached protected-base worktree, uses the exact trusted BASE_SHA as both DIFF_BASE and APPROVED_BASE_SHA, never calls discover-setup-boundary, runs the existing check-boundary, and validates every emitted task root. DESCENDANT and the pinned V4 BOOTSTRAP paths are unchanged.

blockingFindings.summary: The canonical factory skeleton does not persist an empty 20-research-output/ directory. canonicalSkeletonFiles() (used by create) emits a .gitkeep for every other empty stage dir (10-input, 50-source-truth-review, 60-correction, 70-validation, 80-closeout) but NOT for 20-research-output. create() makes the empty directory on disk (so local validate passes 19/19), but git cannot track an empty directory, so on any fresh checkout — including real GitHub CI — the directory is absent and lib/validate.mjs fails the 'stage dir present: 20-research-output' check (18/19, RESULT: INVALID).
blockingFindings.effect: Even with the RESEARCH_TASK routing fix, the pilot PR #69 workflow would now fail at the 'Validate discovered task roots' step instead of the enforcement-resolution step. The required reproduction target 'successful validation of the Binance task root' cannot be reached.
blockingFindings.requiredFixLocation: lib/create.mjs / lib/model.mjs (emit 20-research-output/.gitkeep in the canonical skeleton) or lib/validate.mjs (do not require the empty output dir to be present for a committed PREPARED tree)

whyBlocked: The narrow research-task CI routing correction is implemented and proven (ENFORCEMENT: RESEARCH_TASK, BOUNDARY mode=RESEARCH_TASK, RESULT: BOUNDARY OK; 222/0 fixtures). However the required reproduction also mandates successful validation of the Binance task root, which fails due to a SEPARATE skeleton-persistence defect whose fix lies in lib/ — outside the allowed write set (.github workflow + fixtures + the two result files). Fabricating the missing directory in CI or skipping task-root validation would weaken enforcement and is prohibited. Per the stored prompt, when the full correction is impossible within the allowed paths, stop with RESEARCH_TASK_CI_CORRECTION_BLOCKED and do not broaden scope.

correctionPrOwnWorkflow.note: The correction PR is a factory-governance PR on main and validates under the existing DESCENDANT path (no research-ops/tasks root in its diff). Its run id and step statuses are recorded in the .md after completion.

recommendedNextOwnerCommand: Authorize a separate narrow correction limited to lib/create.mjs (and/or lib/model.mjs) to add a governed 20-research-output/.gitkeep to the canonical skeleton (and a regression fixture), then re-run the Binance pilot; after both corrections are on main, re-run PR #69 CI to confirm end-to-end research-task validation.
